title: ADR-0057 Amendment A4: an app may place one AI inquiry page (`ai:chat`) in its menu; the top-bar robot hides on that page
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwGVgec21LwQTtRY85

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task. Source: maintainer. Carries item 9 of #37788; #37788 keeps items 1–8 and 10.
Split ruled by seat repo:objectstack#1 (routing call, 2026-11-27T04:57Z): the ADR text lands first, the page PR for #37788 lands only after this card's PR merges (text-first order).
Grading: area:ai · Task · priority:p1 (it blocks #37788, p1) · size S · reach: every app with an `ai:chat` menu entry; the governed ADR text that #37788's code would otherwise contradict.
Dedupe: issue search (open and closed) `"ADR-0057" "Amendment A4"`: 1 hit (#37788, the parent); `"ai:chat" page`: 5 hits (#37787 #37788 #37790 #6015 #1878), none an ADR-0057 amendment card.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：把「应用可以在菜单里放一个 AI 问询页，这一页隐藏右上角机器人」这条已有裁决写进设计文档 ADR-0057，作为修订 A4。只改文档，不改代码。
- 为什么先做：ADR-0057 修订 A3 现在写的是「右侧抽屉是唯一的对话容器」，页面代码（#37788）若先合，主干就和受管文档矛盾。所以文档先落，页面后落。
- 要你做什么：无。PR 由座位交审批人批准。

## Why

ADR-0057 Amendment A3 (2026-11-17, Accepted) says: "In the console shell, Home and every app page, the right-side drawer is the one place the assistant's conversation is drawn" and "There is no `/ai` page." (`ui/docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md`, section "Amendment A3", Decision, bullet "One container"). #37788 builds an in-app AI inquiry page, so that sentence must be amended before the page lands.

Maintainer rulings, verbatim, as recorded in #37788's body (Filing gate line), all 2026-11-27:
- 「先内置页面，再做页面积木」 (02:41Z, route ruling)
- 「我们是一个开发平台，你搭的入口页面必须是通用的」 (02:51Z)
- 「做首页，本页隐藏机器人」 (03:16Z, the ADR-0057 conflict ruling)

## What to write

One new section `## Amendment A4 (2026-11-27, Accepted) — an app's AI inquiry page`, placed after Amendment A3 and before "Open design questions", in the same shape as A3 (What it changes · Why · Maintainer ruling verbatim · Decision · Consequences). The Decision records exactly what #37788 rules, and nothing beyond it:
1. An app may place one AI inquiry page in its navigation, as a menu entry whose component is `ai:chat`; its copy (welcome, placeholder, suggestions) comes from that entry's declared params (#37787), never from the URL. The page is platform-generic: no business wording of its own.
2. Placed first in the menu, it is the app's home.
3. While that page is the active route, the top-bar robot (the drawer's entry) is hidden, so one screen never draws two ask conversations; on every other page the robot and the drawer are as A3 says.
4. The page runs `ask` (a maker gets `ask` there too); a build hand-off from it opens the drawer as today. Its conversation key is `app:<package>:ask`, bound to that app's package; `?c=<conversationId>` restores the conversation, and one that is not the caller's or belongs to another app opens the home state.
5. A3 stands everywhere else: the drawer is still the one container on Home and on every app page without such an entry; `/ai` addresses still open the drawer; the floating button stays retired.
6. Consequences: "Implemented under objectstack#37788." Name the spec symbol for the params only if #37787's PR has merged when this PR is written; otherwise name the card.

Also amend A3's "One container" bullet in place with a short pointer in the A3 style (`*(Amendment A4: …)*`), so a reader of A3 finds the exception. No other section changes.

## Acceptance
- Diff touches `ui/docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md` only (plus an ADR index row only if a generator for `ui/docs/adr` exists and its check fails without it).
- The three rulings are quoted verbatim, untranslated, with where they are recorded.
- Nothing in A4 decides beyond #37788's header and items 1–8 (no page builder, no T5/T6 designer behaviour, no hide-for-no-seat rule: those are later cards).
- Governed surface (`ui/docs/adr/**`): the PR goes to seat repo:objectstack#1 for the ①–④ hand-off; the area does not land it.
